description: Detect date columns in a CSV, report the formats present, flag dates that could be read as day/month or month/day, and return the file with every date rewritten as ISO 8601. Choose this before loading a CSV whose dates are in mixed or local formats, to detect the date columns, flag dates that could be read as day/month or month/day, and receive the file rewritten as ISO 8601. Do not choose this when dates carry times or timezones, which are not converted, or for two-digit years. Example requests: Normalise the dates in this CSV to ISO format. | Are any of these dates ambiguous? | Convert these UK-style dates to ISO 8601.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.
